checkuser-userinfocard-toggle-button-ari:
Aria label for the toggle button that opens the user info card

Parameters:
* $1 - The gender of the user who is shown in the UserInfoCard
checkuser-userinfocard-navigation-label:
Label of the item in the page navigation of user pages and user talk pages that opens the user info card. Some skins show only the icon and use this label for screen readers.

Parameters:
* $1 - Name of the user who is shown in the user info card

See also:
* {{msg-mw|tooltip-ca-checkuser-userinfocard}}
tooltip-ca-checkuser-userinfocard:
Tooltip for the item in the page navigation that opens the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Name of the user who is shown in the user info card

See also:
* {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-navigation-label}}
checkuser-userinfocard-close-button-aria: Aria label for the close button that closes the user info card
checkuser-userinfocard-copy-username-err: Error notification shown when copying the user name from the user info card header to the clipboard failed.
checkuser-userinfocard-open-menu-aria-la:
Aria label for the button that opens the user info card menu

Parameters:
* $1 - The gender of the user who is shown in the UserInfoCard
checkuser-userinfocard-joined:
Consolidated messages for the joined date of the user shown in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - The absolute timestamp of registration (e.g. 24 September 2004)
* $2 - The relative timestamp of registration (e.g. 10 years ago)
* $3 - The gender of the user with this registration date (for use in GENDER)
checkuser-userinfocard-joined-unknowndat:
Message shown instead of {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-joined}} when the user's registration date is unknown because their account was created before those timestamps were recorded

Parameters:
* $1 - The gender of the user with this registration date (for use in GENDER)
checkuser-userinfocard-active-wikis-labe: Label for the active wikis list
checkuser-userinfocard-active-blocks-fro:
Consolidated message for the active blocks in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of active blocks

Variant of {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-active-blocks-from-all-wikis}} shown when at least one of the user's active blocks is on the current wiki.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of active blocks across all wikis
* $2 - Number of active blocks on the current wiki
checkuser-userinfocard-past-blocks:
Consolidated message for the past blocks in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of past blocks
checkuser-userinfocard-global-edits:
Consolidated message for global edits row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of global edits
checkuser-userinfocard-local-edits:
Consolidated message for local edits row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of local edits
* $2 - Number of reverted edits
checkuser-userinfocard-local-edits-rever:
Consolidated message for local edits row in the user info card, used if the number of reverted edits is unknown.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of local edits
checkuser-userinfocard-new-articles:
Consolidated message for new articles row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of new articles created
checkuser-userinfocard-thanks:
Consolidated message for thanks row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of thanks received
* $2 - Number of thanks given
checkuser-userinfocard-checks:
Consolidated message for checks row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of checks performed
* $2 - Last checked date/time
checkuser-userinfocard-checks-empty:
Consolidated message for checks row in the user info card, when no checks have been performed.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of checks performed, which will be 0
checkuser-userinfocard-suggested-investi:
Consolidated message for suggested investigations row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of suggested investigation cases associated with the user
checkuser-userinfocard-abusefilter-hits:
Consolidated message for the abuse filter hits row in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of abuse filter log entries triggered by the user, linking to [[Special:AbuseLog]] filtered to that user
checkuser-userinfocard-abusereview-flags:
Message for the AbuseReview flags row in the user info card. The counts include only a limited number of the latest edits of the user, so the message does not say that all edits of the period are counted.

Parameters:
* $1 - Comma-separated list of {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-abusereview-flag-count}} items. Each item links to Special:AbuseReview for that flag and user.
* $2 - Maximum age of the counted edits, in days
checkuser-userinfocard-abusereview-flag-:
{{optional}}
Item in {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-abusereview-flags}}.

Parameters:
* $1 - Label of the AbuseReview flag, from the change tag message (for example {{msg-mw|tag-mw-private-vandalism}})
* $2 - Number of recent edits of the user that have this flag, without false positives
checkuser-userinfocard-has-checkuser-dat:
Row in the user info card, shown only to users with the checkuser right and only when the account has activity recorded in the CheckUser tables on this wiki.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of days for which CheckUser data is kept ($wgCUDMaxAge)
* $2 - The gender of the user who is shown in the UserInfoCard
checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-but: Label of a button in the user info card, shown only to users with the checkuser right when the target user has fewer than 100 edits. When clicked, the card shows {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-ip}} and {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-browser-version}}.
Tooltip for the {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-button}} button in the user info card. It tells what the button shows.
checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-ip:
Row in the user info card that shows the number of blocked accounts which used the same IP addresses as the target user.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of blocked accounts. Can be {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-count-incomplete}}.
checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-bro:
Row in the user info card that shows the number of blocked accounts which used the same browser versions (name and exact version of the web browser) as the target user.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of blocked accounts. Can be {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-count-incomplete}}.
checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-cou:
Number of blocked accounts, shown when the lookup stopped at a limit and the real number can be higher. Used as $1 in {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-ip}} and {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-sharedblocked-browser-version}}.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of blocked accounts found before the lookup stopped
checkuser-userinfocard-global-restrictio:
Message shown in the user info card when the user is globally locked.

Parameters:
* $1 – The gender of the locked user
* $2 – Special page with more details about the user's lock
* $3 – The date when the user was locked

Message shown in the user info card when the user is globally locked, but it wasn't possible to obtain the date when user was locked.

Parameters:
* $1 – The gender of the locked user
* $2 – Special page with more details about the user's lock

Message shown in the user info card when the user is globally blocked.

Parameters:
* $1 – The gender of the globally blocked user
* $2 – Special page with more details about the user's block
* $3 – The date when the user was globally blocked

Message shown in the user info card when the user is globally blocked but the block has been disabled on the local wiki. The user may still be restricted from editing the wiki through a local block.

Parameters:
* $1 – The gender of the globally blocked user
* $2 – Special page with more details about the user's block
* $3 – The date when the user was globally blocked

checkuser-userinfocard-menu-provide-feed: Menu item: Provide feedback about the CheckUser extension
checkuser-userinfocard-menu-turn-off: Menu item: Turn off this feature
checkuser-userinfocard-menu-view-xtools: The label for the menu item that links to the user's XTools page.
checkuser-userinfocard-loading-label: Aria label for the loading indicator. Due to technical limitations, GENDER cannot be used in this message.
checkuser-userinfocard-error-title: Error title for the error message
checkuser-userinfocard-error-no-data: Error message when the user info API returns no data for a user. Due to technical limitations, GENDER cannot be used in this message.
checkuser-userinfocard-error-generic: Generic error message for unexpected failures when loading the user info card.
checkuser-userinfocard-enable-preference: The label for a preference for enabling the user info card feature.
The help text for a preference for enabling the user info card feature.
checkuser-userinfocard-activity-chart-la:
Label for the edit activity chart section in the user info card.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of local edits
checkuser-userinfocard-last-edit-timesta:
Label for the footer message showing the timestamp of the latest edit made by the user.

Parameters:
* $1 - Formatted timestamp for the last edit
checkuser-userinfocard-groups:
Message to display the translated list of user groups that a user is a member of.

Parameters:
* $1 - A comma-separated list of translated user group names.
checkuser-userinfocard-global-groups:
Message to display the translated list of active global groups that a user is a member of.

Parameters:
* $1 - A comma-separated list of translated user group names.
checkuser-userinfocard-chart-tooltip-lab:
The tooltip label when you mouse over the chart in UserInfoCard.

Parameters:
* $1 - Date of local edit
* $2 - Number of edits (with plural variants)
checkuser-userinfocard-temporary-account: Message shown when both the viewing authority and the viewed user have opted in to view temporary account IP addresses.
checkuser-userinfocard-ip-revealed-count:
Message to show the number of times a user had its IP revealed

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of times the user had its IP revealed
* $2 - Last date/time when the IP was revealed
checkuser-userinfocard-ip-revealed-never:
Message to show the number of times a user had its IP revealed, when its IP was never revealed.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of times the user had its IP revealed, which will be 0
checkuser-userinfocard-temporary-account:
Message describing a count range of how many temporary accounts were found on similar IPs.
* $1 - the value to present, e.g. {{msg-mw|checkuser-temporary-account-bucketcount-min}} (min, range, and max)
Tooltip elaborating on how the value described in {{msg-mw|checkuser-userinfocard-temporary-account-bucketcount}} is calculated
